Accepted three-state strip: native/3x whole/triggered/spent or whole/hurt/wreck drawings, shared scale/contact and actual Godot outcomes reviewed.

Accepted vertical wear module only: a broad authored stone/wood break remains readable in the narrow projection. Post/horizontal are superseded by hurt-r1 because their reduction was too low to distinguish at native size.

Accepted post and horizontal wear modules only: chipped upper post and broken rail/masonry section survive the shared reduction and are not hidden under the center post. Vertical/wreck unused in favor of the matching older projections.
Rejected: North-south piece depicts a pair of upright posts instead of longitudinal rails and is too short at the common horizontal span scale.
Rejected: Longitudinal beam is still too short to cover an occupied-cell connection at the common scale. Request only length/camera correction.

Accepted vertical and low wreck modules only. Post/horizontal remain rejected: insufficient height at the shared reduction scale. Earlier full-family rejection is retained separately; this selection is explicitly partial.
